key_highlights: ASX falls sharply as US-Iran strikes push oil to two-month high, spiking bond yields and reigniting rate-hike fears
Housing market under severe stress: analysts warn of 10% price decline, fourth RBA rate hike looming, mega-developer Bathla nears insolvency in 'Evergrande moment'
CSL signs Trump-administration deal to slash medicine prices, creating margin pressure for Australia's largest healthcare exporter
Qantas ground crews vote for right to strike amid pay dispute, adding operational risk to QAN.AX
Coal sector booms on energy demand; gold and silver sink on rate-hike expectations and USD strength
Top central banker warns AI sector could spark global economic downturn via contagion risk
Inflation confirmed as domestically driven, complicating RBA policy path

sectors.trend: Mixed. Coal booms on energy demand (positive for BHP.AX, BRL.AX, WDS.AX). Gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and silver under pressure from rate-hike expectations and USD strength. Exploration successes at King River (44g/t gold), Moonlight (diamonds), Viking (tungsten), McLaren (titanium), Larvotto (antimony) signal pipeline strength. Mineral Resources (MIN.AX) ASIC investigation closed with no action on Ellison.
sectors.implications: Coal and industrial metals outperform; gold miners face near-term headwinds. Exploration-stage names offer speculative upside. MIN.AX de-risked post-ASIC.

sectors.trend: Negative. Fourth RBA rate hike fears pressure NIMs and credit growth. Housing crash risk (10% decline) threatens mortgage books. CBA.AX hit by 13-year inactive-card fee scandal. ASIC flags home insurance short-changing. Developer insolvencies (Bathla) raise NPL concerns.
sectors.implications: Banks face dual squeeze: rate pressure on margins and rising credit risk from property. CBA.AX reputational damage. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Oil at two-month high on US-Iran strikes. Diesel shock described as structural. LNG and coal benefit from energy demand. Geopolitical premium embedded in crude.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BRL.AX, BHP.AX (coal) benefit. Downstream refiners face margin compression. AUD supported by commodity strength.

sectors.trend: CSL.AX signs Trump-administration deal to slash medicine prices, compressing US revenue margins. Offsets broader defensive appeal of sector.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX faces near-term margin headwind from US pricing pressure. Domestic healthcare (SGH.AX, IAG.AX) less affected.

sectors.trend: Housing affordability crisis intensifies. Negative gearing 'rent bomb' fails to ignite politically. Renters see some respite. Retail weak: Denny's rival, firearms retailer, 161-year-old kids clothing brand all in distress. Jetstar (JLH.AX) launches Western Sydney Airport route.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. Consumer discretionary under stress. JLH.AX benefits from new airport capacity.

sectors.trend: AI contagion warning from top central banker. Canva (CVA.AX) in employee-privacy legal fight. Star (SGH.AX) casino woes blamed on prior management. Qantas (QAN.AX) ground-crew strike vote adds operational risk.
sectors.implications: Tech valuations vulnerable to AI-bubble deflation. QAN.AX faces strike risk. SGH.AX turnaround uncertain.

key_themes: Geopolitical risk premium: US-Iran strikes driving oil, yields, and risk-off flows
Housing market stress: 10% price decline forecast, developer insolvencies, rate-hike fears
RBA policy dilemma: home-grown inflation vs. growth slowdown
Commodity divergence: coal/energy strong, gold/silver weak on rate expectations
AI sector contagion risk flagged by central bankers
Corporate governance and regulatory scrutiny (ASIC, Icac, CBA fees)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US-Iran geopolitical escalation driving oil spike and global risk-off
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; maintain cash buffers; monitor Iran retaliation timeline

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Australian housing market correction (10%+ decline) and developer insolvencies
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and home-loan exposure; favour banks with strong capital buffers (CBA.AX, NAB.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fourth RBA rate hike and sustained home-grown inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour fixed-income and dividend-paying defensives; avoid rate-sensitive growth

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI sector contagion and global debt spiral
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from concentrated tech/AI positions; monitor global credit spreads

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Qantas strike action and operational disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce QAN.AX exposure pre-strike vote; monitor industrial relations

risk_assessment.risk_factor: CSL US pricing pressure from Trump administration deal
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reassess CSL.AX margin trajectory; consider domestic healthcare alternatives

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight coal and energy producers on two-month oil high and structural diesel demand
opportunities.rationale: US-Iran premium and coal boom support earnings; WDS.AX and BRL.AX benefit from energy security theme

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to exploration-stage miners with recent assay successes
opportunities.rationale: King River, Moonlight, Viking, McLaren, Larvotto results signal pipeline depth; MIN.AX de-risked post-ASIC

opportunities.recommendation: Position in dividend-paying defensives ahead of potential rate hike
opportunities.rationale: Consumer staples and utilities offer yield and capital preservation in rate-hike environment

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure; trim housing-linked credit
defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house price decline forecast, Bathla insolvency risk, and negative gearing debate create downside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge gold and silver positions; favour USD-hedged commodity exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate-hike expectations and USD strength pressure precious metals; gold sank post-Iran strikes

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim QAN.AX and CSL.AX ahead of strike vote and US pricing deal impact
defensive_moves.rationale: Qantas strike risk and CSL margin compression create near-term volatility

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash allocation and monitor global credit spreads for AI contagion
defensive_moves.rationale: Central-banker warning on AI-driven downturn and global debt spiral warrant caution

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) faces continued downward pressure from oil-driven inflation, rate-hike fears, and housing stress. Geopolitical premium from US-Iran strikes adds volatility. Expect 3–5% index decline over 1–3 months unless de-escalation occurs. Coal and energy outperform; banks, REITs, and gold lag.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Home-grown inflation and housing correction may force RBA to pause or cut, supporting equities later. Coal and LNG structural demand supports materials. AI sector re-rating risk and global debt spiral are key tail risks. CSL US pricing deal may normalise over time. Housing stabilisation likely by H2 2027.

Global AI/tech earnings and credit spreads
Iron ore and LNG contract pricing

RBA cash rate and CPI data
